claims.text: The Jasper architecture serves as a baseline for exploring more sophisticated techniques in speech recognition.
The performance of the Jasper model was evaluated on the Hub5 Year 2000 dataset, which is a standard benchmark in the field.
Jasper's architecture is built on a stack of 1D-convolution layers, batch normalization, ReLU, and dropout, which are optimized for training and inference.
